anomalies.description: A man in dark robes is seen repeatedly pressing his hand onto the chest/abdomen of a supine, seemingly unconscious or restrained individual lying on a table; the victim shows visible bloodstains on clothing and appears helpless throughout the sequence.

A man lies helpless on a table while another person uses a sharp instrument to cut into his abdomen, with visible blood and deliberate incision; two others observe passively, indicating non-consensual medical or torturous procedure.
The abdominal incision continues under supervision of multiple onlookers; the victim remains immobile and vulnerable, with active manipulation of the wound by the central figure.
